text:
Maya: FYI noticed a weird quality drift after rolling int8 for the new Falcon-13 variant on customer slices. short summary: cost -42% but longform ROUGE-L down ~1.8pts on our summarization slice.
Devon: ouch. which slice and sample size?
Maya: 2k docs, mixed-length (avg 1.2k tokens), slice=product-help-centers. export attached to GH gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/abc123 (tables + seed prompts)
Olga: can you paste the exact eval command? maybe priming/shotting changed.
Maya: run used eval harness v2.1, cmd: `python eval.py --model falcon-13b.int8 --batch 8 --seed 42 --priming template_v3`
Sam: latency/throughput impact?
Maya: p50 +6ms, p95 +18ms, mean token/sec down ~8%. weird because int8 should be faster; kernel explains show more GEMM spill.
Nora: did we change KV cache handling for long contexts? that kills perf on longform sometimes.
Maya: good call. config shows kvcache=false for that worker pool during rollout (accidental).
Devon: that could explain latency. quality though? quant can shift logits and cause repetition/regressions on long outputs. do we have sample diffs?
EvalBot: Automated diff summary: 1) Increased repetition rate +3.2% on tail answers. 2) Rouge-L -1.8 points (p<0.01). 3) Compression-preserving prompts downed recall on factual sections.
Olga: hypothesis: degraded kvcache + int8 numeric drift => longer context generation loops and more degenerate tokens. propose A/B: revert kvcache=false and rerun int8, and also run int6 hybrid (kv cache on cpu) on a 200-sample quickcheck.
Sam: agree. also recommend routing policy: for responses >512 tokens route to int16 fallback, otherwise keep int8. we can do gradual holdback for 5% traffic.
Maya: action items: 1) Devon toggle kvcache=true on staging pool (DEV-1472) 2) Olga run 200-sample quickcheck for int8/int6/int16 by EOD 3) Sam draft routing flag config (canary 5%) 4) Nora add regression alert for repetition-rate +2%
Devon: toggled on staging, smoke looks good so far. logs: `kvcache restored, avg latency back to baseline`
Olga: quickcheck results (200 samples): int8 w/kvcache: Rouge-L delta -0.3, repeat +0.8%; int6 hybrid: Rouge-L delta -0.5, repeat +1.0%; int16: baseline within noise.
Maya: nice — much smaller quality hit when kvcache is on. cost tradeoffs?
Sam: updated econ calc: with kvcache on, int8 still ~38% cheaper than int16 per-token. routing 95%->int8, 5%->int16 yields ~35% cost reduction with <0.2pt expected turnout on aggregate metrics.
Nora: propose shipping holdback + canary: 5% traffic to int16 fallback on long responses, monitor repetition-rate, rouge, and latency tails for 48h.
Maya: +1. I'll prep a short scorecard for GTN: include sample diffs, quickcheck table, econ slide, and rollout plan.
Devon: sounds good. tagging @platform to prep rollout flags: @platform please watch DEV-1472.
Sam: adding checklist to release: telemetry hooks (repetition-rate), traffic split flag, auto-fallback on kvcache exceptions. :white_check_mark:
Maya: thanks all — follow-ups in a pinned thread.
